title: Certified exact minima of Kochen-Specker sets inside coordinate pools: 31 and 33 rays in dimension three, 18 in dimension four, 29 in dimension five
peer_review_status: Research preprint (not peer reviewed; AI-assisted under human direction; 6-kernel Lean 4.35.0 repository CI verified)
author: Alexander Stephen Donahue

lean_verification.framework: Lean 4.35.0 (zero Mathlib, 30 explicit #print axioms + exhaustive 149-theorem Lean.collectAxioms audit in KS/Audit.lean, independent lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution, 3 adversarial false-variant Lean refutations, and 6 independent kernels via lake comparator --paranoid in repository CI run 45741815040, Sigstore Rekor logIndex 4116355625)

core_result: Certifies exact minimum Kochen-Specker set sizes inside finite coordinate pools: 31 in 3D integer pools (|c|<=2,3,4), 33 in 3D N-th roots of unity (N=6,12,18,24), 18 in 4D {0,+1,-1}, and 29 in 5D {0,+1,-1}, using Lean 4 proofs and independently checked DRUP unsatisfiability certificates.
verification_boundary: Bound-2 3D minimum (31) and 4D minimum (18), plus non-vacuity 30-ray and 17-ray witnesses, are kernel-checked in pure Lean 4.35.0 without Mathlib (exhaustive 149-theorem KS namespace axiom audit + 30 explicit #print axioms, 0 disallowed axioms), replayed independently by lake env leanchecker --fresh Solution, tested against 3 adversarial false-variant Lean refutations, and verified across 6 independent kernels (lean, leanchecker-paranoid, lean4lean, nanoda, con-leche, con-ron) via lake comparator --paranoid in CI (run 45741815040, Sigstore Rekor logIndex 4116355625; Release v1.9.0 run 45744236042 Rekor logIndex 4116572137); zero-warning C11 DRUP/QGTL/QRNG engines pass ASan/LSan/UBSan, 59/59 Node verifier checks pass, 33/33 Crossref DOIs have 0 retractions, ks-minimum.pdf compiles with literal 0.00pt overfull hboxes (with CRediT & ERRATA.md), Build Standard v1.2.0 (10 finding classes, Draft 2020-12 schema-valid repo.yaml) scores 98.4% (63/64, A24 honestly partial for 2 pinned cut-certificate JSONs >5 MB), and SHA-256-verified gitleaks v8.30.1 + osv-scanner v2.7.1 report zero leaks; larger pools rest on independently checked DRUP certificates. Explicitly notes the general unrestricted minimal-KS problem (QM-011) remains open (0/1,900 Mega-Atlas grand problems solved).
